title: Identify sheaf tensor uncurrying from pre-sheafification values
statement: Let R be a sheaf of commutative rings on a small site with the sheafification hypotheses of SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory. For R-module sheaves A,B,N, a morphism f:A tensor B -> N and psi:A -> homObj B N [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed], suppose that for every site object U and sections x of A(U), y of B(U), f applied to homTensorSectionMap R A B of x tensor y [lem-sc-hom-tensor-degreewise] equals psi(x) evaluated at y at the identity object of Over U. Then f equals the symmetry A tensor B -> B tensor A followed by the inverse tensor-Hom adjunction applied to psi.

source.place: tensorHomEquiv; tensorObjIsoSheafification and sheafificationAdjunction; Stacks 03EK and 0A90

proof.text: Naturality of the sheafification unit and the braided tensorator identify pre-sheafification with braiding. Cancelling the tensor comparison in the sheaf tensor-Hom equivalence identifies its inverse before sheafification with presheaf uncurrying. Its value after braiding on x tensor y is psi(x) evaluated at y.

The supplied hypothesis gives equality on pure tensors at each site object. ModuleCat tensor extensionality and presheaf hom extensionality give equality of the presheaf maps. Injectivity of the sheafification adjunction and cancellation of the tensor comparison give equality of the sheaf maps.

theorem tensorHom_of_pureTensor (A B N : Mod) :
    letI := monoidalCategory R
    letI := symmetricCategory R
    ∀ (f : A ⊗ B ⟶ N) (ψ : A ⟶ homObj (R := R) B N),
      (∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : A.val.obj U) (y : B.val.obj U),
        (f.val.app U).hom
          (((homTensorSectionMap R A B).app U).hom (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj U] y)) =
        (((ψ.val.app U).hom x).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U.unop)))).hom y) →
      f = (β_ A B).hom ≫ (tensorHomEquiv B A N).symm ψ
